# openmetadata_worksheet (Resource)

Manages an OpenMetadata worksheet. Worksheets are the tabs inside a spreadsheet and inherit the service of their spreadsheet.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "openmetadata_drive_service" "google_drive" {
  name         = "google-drive"
  service_type = "GoogleDrive"
}

resource "openmetadata_spreadsheet" "budget" {
  name    = "budget"
  service = openmetadata_drive_service.google_drive.name
}

resource "openmetadata_worksheet" "q1" {
  name         = "q1"
  spreadsheet  = openmetadata_spreadsheet.budget.fully_qualified_name
  display_name = "Q1 budget"
  description  = "First-quarter budget figures."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Worksheet name. Changing it replaces the worksheet, because the name is part of its fully qualified name.
- `spreadsheet` (String) Fully qualified name of the parent spreadsheet. Changing it replaces the worksheet.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Markdown description of the worksheet.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name shown in the OpenMetadata UI.

### Read-Only

- `fully_qualified_name` (String) Fully qualified name, in the form spreadsheet.worksheet.
- `id` (String) Server-assigned UUID.
- `service` (String) Fully qualified name of the drive service, derived by the server from the spreadsheet.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time in RFC 3339 format.
- `updated_by` (String) User that performed the last update.
- `version` (Number) Server-side entity version.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by UUID.
terraform import openmetadata_worksheet.q1 1f6a3a52-8d34-4f4b-9d0f-2f1c1c1c1c1c

# Or import by fully qualified name, in the form spreadsheet.worksheet.
terraform import openmetadata_worksheet.q1 google-drive.budget.q1
```
